articles.title: Meta发布AI助手Muse，主打个人助理
articles.summary: Meta推出名为Muse的AI个人助理，能访问用户的邮件、日历、支付等，试图在AI竞赛中追赶。
articles.why: 这是Meta最大规模的消费者AI产品，可能改变日常使用习惯，但隐私问题值得关注。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注Muse如何申请和使用，但注意它要求访问大量个人数据。
articles.for_me: 可以关注Muse的后续评测，看它能否帮你管理日程或辅助学习，但先别急着用，等隐私政策明朗。

articles.title: Anthropic遭集体诉讼：高级订阅误导用户
articles.summary: 用户起诉Anthropic，称其高级订阅承诺的权益未兑现，误导了重度用户。
articles.why: 涉及订阅服务的诚信问题，影响用户对AI付费产品的信任。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 订阅AI服务前仔细阅读条款，别轻信宣传。
articles.for_me: 如果你考虑付费使用Claude，先等等诉讼结果，或选择更透明的订阅方案。

articles.title: 谷歌发布人类基因组AI图谱
articles.summary: 谷歌DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，可预测DNA变化，助力疾病治疗研究。
articles.why: 这是AI在科学领域的重大突破，可能加速医学进步，但离普通人较远。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解AI在医疗领域的潜力，但不用急于跟进。
articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，除非你对生物科技感兴趣，但可留意未来是否影响健康服务。

articles.title: Adobe Premiere新增AI生成工具，简化视频编辑
articles.summary: Premiere推出Generative Media工具，可在时间线上直接生成视频、音效等，无需切换软件。
articles.why: 大幅降低视频创作门槛，对内容创作者是福音。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 如果你做视频，可以试试Premiere的新AI功能，省时省力。
articles.for_me: 对英语专业可能用不上，但如果你未来想做自媒体或教学视频，值得关注。

articles.title: 黑客盗取Claude用户令牌，账号安全告急
articles.summary: 有Claude用户账号被黑客盗用，消耗大量token，Anthropic已发出警告。
articles.why: 提醒所有AI服务用户注意账号安全，避免损失。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 开启双重验证，定期检查账号使用情况。
articles.for_me: 如果你用Claude，马上检查账号安全设置，别让黑客偷走你的订阅。

articles.title: AI编程公司Cognition估值达480亿美元
articles.summary: Cognition获高估值，显示投资者认为AI编程市场仍有竞争空间。
articles.why: 反映AI编程工具前景，但普通人可能用不上。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注AI编程趋势，但非技术背景可暂缓。
articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，除非你考虑转行编程，但可留意AI工具是否降低编程门槛。

articles.title: OpenAI被指在数学难题上作弊
articles.summary: NYU数学家指控OpenAI在解决Navier-Stokes问题上使用不正当手段。
articles.why: 涉及学术诚信，可能影响AI在科研领域的可信度。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 对AI的学术成果保持批判性，别全盘相信。
articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，但如果你备考AI研究生，注意学术伦理问题。

articles.title: Chrome更新提速至两周一次，应对AI安全
articles.summary: 谷歌将Chrome更新频率改为每两周一次，以更快修复安全漏洞和推出新功能。
articles.why: AI时代安全威胁加剧，浏览器更新加快影响所有网民。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 保持浏览器自动更新，确保安全。
articles.for_me: 对你有用，因为浏览器是日常工具，更新快能减少被攻击风险。

articles.title: AI视频工具vivago R1实测，普通人也能做大片
articles.summary: 爱范儿实测全球上线的AI视频工具vivago R1，用它制作了赛博西游记短片。
articles.why: AI视频生成门槛降低，普通人也能创作专业级视频。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以尝试用vivago R1制作短视频，体验AI创作。
articles.for_me: 对你有用，你可以用它制作英语学习视频或创意作品，提升表达能力。

articles.title: AI开始互发微信，智能体间沟通引关注
articles.summary: AI智能体之间开始互相发送消息，引发对自主沟通的担忧。
articles.why: AI自主交互可能带来失控风险，但也是未来趋势。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解AI智能体概念，但别恐慌，目前仍受控。
articles.for_me: 值得关注，因为未来AI可能帮你处理邮件、日程，但需留意安全性。

plain_summary: 今天AI圈动静不小：Meta推出了个人助理Muse，想让你把生活交给它，但隐私问题得留心；谷歌的基因组AI是科学大事，但离你有点远；Adobe让视频剪辑更傻瓜，适合创作者；还有黑客偷Claude账号，提醒你注意安全。另外，AI视频工具越来越强，普通人也能做大片了。整体看，AI正在渗透日常工具，但安全和信任问题也在浮现。你作为新手，先别急着追新，挑几个靠谱的用起来，比如AI视频或剪辑工具，同时保护好账号。

top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: AI助手性能优化系统，提升编码效率与安全性
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个针对AI编程助手的性能优化系统，它通过添加技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，让Claude Code、Codex等AI工具更聪明、更可靠。它解决的是AI助手在复杂任务中容易出错、遗忘上下文或产生安全风险的问题。普通人可以用它来让AI写代码更准确，比如让它记住项目规范，避免重复犯错。创作者可以定制AI的行为，让它更符合自己的开发习惯。它适合程序员使用，需要一定的技术基础，但上手不算难，因为提供了现成的配置和插件。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 能随你成长的AI代理框架
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个AI代理框架，核心特点是‘与你一起成长’，意味着它能根据你的使用习惯和反馈不断优化自身行为。它解决的是通用AI助手不够个性化的问题，让AI更懂你的需求。普通人可以用它来搭建个人助理，比如让它学习你的日程安排和偏好，自动帮你管理邮件或提醒。创作者可以基于它开发定制化的AI应用，比如教育辅导或健康管理。它需要一定的编程知识，但提供了友好的接口，适合有Python基础的开发者尝试。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让每个人都能用的自主AI助手
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT是一个开源项目，目标是让AI人人可用，它允许你创建能自主完成任务的AI代理，比如自动搜索信息、写报告或管理项目。它解决的是传统AI需要一步步指令的问题，你只需给出目标，它就能自己规划并执行。普通人可以用它来自动化日常任务，比如让它帮你整理研究资料并生成摘要。创作者可以基于它构建复杂的自动化工作流。它需要一些技术知识，但社区提供了大量教程，适合有一定编程基础且想探索AI自动化的人。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 一键运行多种大模型的本地工具
top_starred.explanation: Ollama是一个让你在本地电脑上轻松运行各种大语言模型的工具，比如DeepSeek、Qwen等。它解决了云端AI依赖网络和隐私问题，让你离线也能用AI。普通人可以用它来本地聊天或写作，无需上传数据，保护隐私。创作者可以下载模型进行微调或开发应用。它非常容易上手，只需安装并运行命令即可，适合所有对AI感兴趣的人，即使不懂技术也能快速使用。

top_starred.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
top_starred.desc: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥
top_starred.tagline: 大规模网页搜索与抓取的API
top_starred.explanation: Firecrawl是一个提供网页搜索和抓取服务的API，它能高效地从互联网上提取数据，并支持大规模操作。它解决的是手动复制网页信息效率低的问题，让开发者能快速获取结构化数据。普通人可以用它来收集市场信息或监控新闻，但需要一点编程知识。创作者可以将其集成到自己的应用中，比如自动抓取商品价格或文章内容。它适合需要大量网页数据的开发者，上手难度中等，有清晰的文档。

trending.name: Nanako0129/sepia
trending.desc: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
trending.tagline: 让AI写作更自然，去除机器味
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个写作技能包，能让AI生成的文字更自然，减少生硬感。它基于学术研究，针对小说和职业写作提供不同风格优化。它解决的是AI写作常有的‘机器味’问题，让文字更流畅、更有人情味。普通人可以用它来润色文章或小说，让AI写出的故事更吸引人。创作者可以将其集成到写作工具中。它需要与支持Agent Skills的AI配合使用，比如Claude Code，上手有一定门槛，但效果显著。

trending.name: Player-YN/PawWork_ZhuaZhua
trending.desc: Paw Work - selection-first web agent for Chrome: select on the live page, describe the outcome, take away an editable office file. BYOK, sandboxed, no server.
trending.tagline: 在网页上直接操作生成办公文件的AI
trending.explanation: 这是一个Chrome浏览器扩展，让你在网页上直接选择内容，然后描述你想要的结果，它就能生成可编辑的办公文件（如Word、Excel）。它解决的是从网页复制数据到办公软件繁琐的问题。普通人可以用它来快速整理网页上的表格或文章，比如把在线报价单转成Excel。创作者可以定制自动化流程。它无需服务器，数据安全，适合经常处理网页信息的办公人员，上手简单，只需安装扩展即可。

trending.name: 2akouwu/reverify
trending.desc: Stop your AI from making things up — it proposes, deterministic tools decide, every claim checked against ground truth with evidence. Grounded facts and context survive resets. Reverse engineering is the proving ground. MCP server + CLI.
trending.tagline: 防止AI胡说八道的验证工具
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个工具，能确保AI的回答基于事实，减少编造。它通过让AI提出建议，然后用确定性工具验证每个声明，并附上证据。它解决的是AI幻觉问题，即AI会自信地给出错误信息。普通人可以用它来验证AI提供的信息，比如在医疗或法律咨询中。创作者可以将其集成到AI应用中，提高可靠性。它适合对准确性要求高的场景，需要一定技术知识，但提供了命令行和MCP服务器，方便使用。

trending.name: Human-Agent-Society/reef
trending.desc: Continual learning infra for self-improving agents
trending.tagline: 让AI代理持续学习自我提升的基础设施
trending.explanation: 这个项目提供持续学习的基础设施，让AI代理能不断从经验中学习并改进自己。它解决的是AI代理在部署后无法更新知识的问题。普通人可能不直接使用，但创作者可以基于它构建能适应新环境的AI系统，比如客服机器人能不断学习新问题。它需要较强的技术背景，涉及机器学习和系统设计，适合AI研究人员和高级开发者，上手难度较高。

trending.name: datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang
trending.desc: 面向大模型开发者的 SGLang 系统化开源教程：从推理基础与环境搭建开始，逐步学习模型部署、结构化生成、服务开发和性能优化，   结合实战案例带你从 0 到 1 掌握 SGLang，构建高性能 LLM 推理应用
trending.tagline: 中文SGLang教程，从入门到精通
trending.explanation: 这是一个面向大模型开发者的中文教程，系统讲解SGLang框架，从基础到高级，包括模型部署、性能优化等。它解决的是SGLang学习资源少、门槛高的问题，让中文开发者能快速上手。普通人如果想学习AI推理优化，可以跟着教程一步步实践。创作者可以用它来构建高性能的AI服务。它适合有Python基础的开发者，教程详细，上手难度中等，是学习SGLang的优质资源。

spaces.name: pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator
spaces.tagline: 鸭子机器人模拟器，让你在虚拟世界操控小鸭子
spaces.explanation: 这是一个模拟器应用，就像是一个虚拟的游乐场，里面有一只小鸭子机器人（Microduck），你可以控制它走来走去、做各种动作。它主要用于测试和展示机器人控制算法，但普通人也可以把它当作一个有趣的玩具，体验一下编程控制机器人的感觉。比如，你可以通过简单的指令让鸭子转圈、前进，就像玩遥控车一样。上手难度不高，即使不懂技术，也能通过界面上的按钮或简单命令来操作。对于想了解AI和机器人的人来说，这是一个直观的入门工具。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/wan555
spaces.desc: generate a video from an image with a text prompt
spaces.tagline: 图片变视频工具，输入图片和文字就能生成动态视频
spaces.explanation: 这个应用可以根据你提供的一张静态图片和一段文字描述，自动生成一段视频。比如，你上传一张小狗的照片，输入“小狗在草地上奔跑”，它就能生成一段小狗奔跑的短视频。这对于普通人来说非常有趣，可以用来制作创意内容，比如把老照片变成动态回忆，或者为社交媒体制作独特视频。上手很简单，只需要上传图片和输入文字，点击生成即可。不过生成效果可能受限于模型能力，但整体来说，这是一个让普通人体验AI视频生成的好工具。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/QWEN_EDIT_IMAGE
spaces.desc: Demo of the Collection of Qwen Image Edit LoRAs
spaces.tagline: 图片编辑工具，用文字指令修改图片内容
spaces.explanation: 这个应用基于Qwen图像编辑模型，你可以通过输入文字指令来修改图片。比如，你有一张自己的照片，输入“给我戴上一顶帽子”，它就会在照片上添加一顶帽子。这对于普通人来说非常实用，可以轻松实现图片的创意修改，无需学习复杂的Photoshop技能。对于学生和AI爱好者，这也是了解多模态AI（同时处理文本和图像）的绝佳例子。上手非常简单，上传图片，输入指令，就能看到修改后的结果。

spaces.name: AimeeBingmouQu/ProtectBirds
spaces.tagline: 保护鸟类应用，可能用于识别或监测鸟类
spaces.explanation: 这个应用名为“保护鸟类”，从名字推测，它可能是一个用于识别鸟类或监测鸟类活动的工具。例如，你可以上传一张鸟类的照片，它能够告诉你这是什么鸟，或者通过摄像头实时识别鸟类。这对于鸟类爱好者、自然观察者或学生来说很有用，可以帮助他们学习鸟类知识，参与公民科学项目。上手难度取决于具体功能，但通常这类应用界面友好，只需上传图片或使用摄像头即可。

spaces.name: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora
spaces.desc: Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack
spaces.tagline: 视频生成工具，能生成带同步音效的视频
spaces.explanation: 这个应用可以根据提示生成视频，并且自动配上与画面同步的音效。比如，你输入“一只猫在钢琴上走路”，它就能生成一段猫走路的视频，同时伴有钢琴声或脚步声。这对于内容创作者来说非常方便，可以快速生成带声音的短视频，无需额外配音。对于普通人，可以用来制作有趣的视频素材。上手简单，只需输入文字描述，点击生成即可。

models.name: XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B
models.tagline: 轻量级文本生成模型，适合在资源有限设备上运行
models.explanation: 这是一个文本生成模型，属于语言模型，可以生成文字、回答问题、写文章等。它的特点是参数规模较小（4B），因此运行起来更轻量，可以在普通电脑甚至手机上运行。对于学生和AI爱好者，可以用它来学习如何部署和使用语言模型，或者构建自己的聊天机器人。例如，你可以用它来练习英语对话，或者让它帮你写作文。上手难度中等，需要一些技术知识来安装和运行，但网上有很多教程。

models.name: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B
models.tagline: 新一代多模态模型，能处理文本和图像
models.explanation: MiniCPM5-2B是一个多模态模型，可以同时理解文本和图像。比如，你可以给它一张图片并问“图片里有什么？”，它能回答你。这对于普通人来说，可以用来做图像识别、图像问答等。对于学生，可以用来学习多模态AI的概念。上手难度中等，需要一些编程基础来调用模型，但也可以使用现成的界面。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
models.tagline: 强大的多模态模型，能看图聊天和回答问题
models.explanation: Qwen3.8-27B是一个大型多模态模型，可以处理图像和文本，进行对话、问答、内容生成等。它的能力很强，比如你可以上传一张复杂的图表，让它解释数据；或者让它根据图片写故事。对于普通人，可以用它来辅助学习、工作，比如快速理解图片内容。对于AI爱好者和备考者，这是了解前沿多模态技术的绝佳案例。上手难度中等，可以通过API或在线演示使用。

models.name: ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF
models.tagline: 压缩版多模态模型，运行更快更省资源
models.explanation: 这个模型是Qwen3.8-27B的压缩版本，通过量化技术减小了模型大小，同时保持接近的性能。它的优点是可以在性能较弱的设备上运行，比如普通笔记本电脑，而无需高端显卡。对于普通用户，这意味着可以更轻松地在本地体验强大的AI功能。对于开发者，它提供了在资源受限环境下部署AI的解决方案。上手难度中等，需要一些技术知识来配置环境。

models.name: google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch
models.tagline: 时间序列预测模型，用于预测未来趋势
models.explanation: TimesFM是一个专门用于时间序列预测的模型，可以分析历史数据并预测未来走势。比如，你可以输入过去一年的每日气温数据，它就能预测未来一周的天气趋势。这对于金融、物流、气象等领域非常有用。对于普通人，可以用来分析自己的消费记录，预测下月支出。对于学生，这是学习AI在数据分析中应用的好例子。上手难度中等，需要一些数据处理知识，但模型提供了Python接口。

items.title_en: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce diffusion-augmented LLMs, a new class of models that defines an AR model distribution while using diffusion to draw multiple tokens in parallel from that distribution. items.title_cn: 通过离散扩散实现LLM无损加速
items.note: 提出扩散增强LLM，并行生成多个token，加速推理且不损失质量，适合关注效率优化的新手。

items.title_en: FlowBalance: Verifier-Grounded Self-Improvement from On-Policy Reasoning Experience
items.summary: A reasoning model can improve from its own on-policy experience, but this inner loop is fragile: terminal verifiers provide reliable yet sparse supervision, while dense same-model guidance can reinforce false confidence or overconcentrate learning on a narrow solution mode. We introduce FlowBalance, a verifier-grounded self-improvement method that learns a normalized distribution over complete responses. items.title_cn: FlowBalance：基于验证器的自我改进方法
items.note: 利用验证器监督策略自身经验，平衡稀疏奖励与密集指导，提升推理模型稳定性，对RL感兴趣可看。

items.title_en: ENEAS: Embedding-guided Neural Ensemble for Adaptive Segmentation
items.summary: We present ENEAS, a unified, text-promptable method for instance tracking and semantic discovery. Text-promptable segmentation models, including the latest foundation models such as SAM 3, still suffer from temporal hallucinations, spatial fragmentation, and semantic misclassification: they fail to report target absence when an object leaves the field of view, segment local textures instead of the complete object during extreme close-ups, and prioritize visual features over ontological reality,

items.note: 统一文本提示的分割模型，解决时间幻觉和空间碎片问题，适合视觉分割方向入门。

items.title_en: Causal Foundation Models
items.summary: Causal inference is the practice of estimating the effect of a treatment or intervention from data. It traditionally requires a bespoke pipeline for every new problem: first proposing a causal mechanism, selecting a compatible estimator, and finally training it. Meanwhile, across diverse settings and modalities, much of machine learning has shifted to the paradigm of foundation models: networks pretrained once at scale and applied to new tasks without fine-tuning. items.title_cn: 因果基础模型
items.note: 探索将因果推断泛化为基础模型范式，无需针对每个任务定制流程，对因果推理和基础模型交叉领域有价值。

items.title_en: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) accelerates post-training by providing dense token-level supervision from a frozen teacher on the student's own rollouts. Vanilla OPD applies this supervision uniformly across prompts, without checking whether the teacher is reliable for each prompt. Because reverse KL is mode-seeking, a confidently wrong teacher can induce a strong yet misleading update. Distributional proxies, such as entropy or teacher-student likelihood agreement, measure uncertainty or agreement
items.title_cn: 先验证再蒸馏：提示级教师门控

items.title_en: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems commonly use an orchestrator to decompose a task for a team of workers and then improve through textual reflection. Despite strong empirical results, these systems lack a unified account of coordination, memory improvement, and the role of external verification. items.title_cn: 双层协调反思：多智能体LLM系统的博弈论方法
items.note: 用博弈论建模多智能体协作与反思，提供统一理论框架，适合对多智能体系统感兴趣者。

items.title_en: Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research
items.summary: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved. We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-agent executors in a controllable and auditable human-in-the-loop workflow rather than introducing another autonomous agent. items.title_cn: Dr. Claw：用于氛围研究的AI科学家工作区
items.note: 开源工作区，封装编码代理为可控可审计流程，支持端到端研究，适合AI辅助科研工具关注者。

items.title_en: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
items.summary: We present Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at the 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, together with the data pipeline and training recipe behind them. items.note: 训练两个搜索代理，通过反向构建多跳任务提升搜索能力，适合信息检索和代理训练方向。

items.title_en: Motion-Omni: End-to-End Joint Speech and Full-Body Motion for Spoken Dialogue
items.summary: An avatar that holds a conversation should decide what to say and to move while saying it, yet these abilities live in separate model families: spoken dialogue models produce speech without motion, and co-speech motion models produce motion only from audio handed to them. The standard remedy is a cascade that first generates the spoken response and then runs a motion model over the finished audio, which requires a second full inference pass and precludes any joint optimisation between the two. items.title_cn: Motion-Omni：端到端语音与全身动作联合生成
items.note: 联合生成对话语音和全身动作，避免级联延迟，适合多模态交互和数字人研究。

items.title_en: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models
items.summary: Audio-video diffusion models rely on cross-modal attention to coordinate text, sound, and visual content, yet this same mechanism can introduce subtle and systematic semantic leakage. We study these models by probing and analyzing the ``attention triangle,'' comprising the three cross-attention edges connecting the text, audio, and video streams, and examine how semantic information is routed across modalities during generation. items.title_cn: 音视频模型中的注意力三角
items.note: 分析音视频扩散模型中跨模态注意力的语义泄漏，揭示生成中的信息路由，适合多模态生成理解。

items.title_en: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
items.summary: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. We present compile by training, which turns a natural-language specification into a reusable neural function. items.title_cn: 通过训练编译：将自然语言规范转化为局部神经函数
items.note: 将文本规范编译为小型神经函数，减少远程模型调用，适合边缘计算和模型压缩。

items.title_en: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
items.summary: As terminal-based code agents become prevalent, agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration. items.title_cn: Terminal-Universe：将代理轨迹转化为可扩展终端环境
items.note: 从代理轨迹构建可执行环境，用于代理后训练，解决环境稀缺问题，适合智能体训练数据生成。

items.title_en: LLaDA-Image: Building Strong Image Generators with Fully Open Training Recipes
items.summary: We introduce LLaDA-Image, a unified framework that pairs a 6B Diffusion Transformer (DiT) trained from scratch with a frozen vision-language understanding module built on the LLaDA2.0-Mini diffusion language model backbone. Instead of relying heavily on paired image-text data from the beginning, we first build a strong visual generative prior through image-only pre-training and mid-training. items.title_cn: LLaDA-Image：完全开放训练流程的强图像生成器
items.note: 开源6B扩散Transformer与冻结VLM结合，强调图像预训练，适合图像生成和开源模型关注者。

items.title_en: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
items.summary: Large language models achieve superior performance on tasks that require extended reasoning, but long chains of thought make the KV cache a severe memory bottleneck. Existing KV cache compression methods share one paradigm: score each cached token by some estimate of how much it will matter later, and keep the top-scoring ones. items.title_cn: 随机注意力：重新思考KV缓存驱逐以高效推理
items.note: 发现KV缓存驱逐中评分信号无用，随机驱逐即可，大幅降低内存，适合推理优化研究。

items.title_en: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
items.summary: Large language models offer broad capabilities, but adapting them to evolving domains, tools, and requirements often entails repeated post-training. Autonomous systems automate parts of this process by proposing updates, training candidates, and using evaluation feedback to select subsequent proposals. items.title_cn: 知道何时不复用：自主LLM后训练中的条件经验迁移
items.note: 研究后训练中哪些历史更新可迁移，避免无效复用，适合持续学习和模型更新。

items.title_en: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
items.summary: Autonomous agents are beginning to carry out machine-learning (ML) research end to end. These agents combine a model backbone with a harness for planning, execution, memory, and verification, but this architecture still leaves domain-specific know-how outside the agent. We call this missing layer operational knowledge, the know-how that separates knowing a method from making it work. That knowledge is not absent from the field. items.title_cn: Repo-To-Skill：将GitHub仓库提炼为AI4AI技能
items.note: 从仓库提取操作知识，增强代理的领域技能，适合AI辅助研究和知识蒸馏。

items.title_en: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
items.summary: As agents move from research prototypes to deployed tools, their capability increasingly depends on model-external execution infrastructure, commonly termed the agent harness. Changing this harness while holding model weights fixed can substantially alter task performance. Current agent evaluations typically report downstream performance under a chosen harness, leaving a model's ability to develop the harness itself comparatively underexplored. items.title_cn: HarnessDev：LLM能否创建和进化自己的代理框架？
items.note: 基准测试评估模型开发自身代理框架的能力，探索模型外部基础设施的自主性。

items.title_en: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
items.summary: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. items.title_cn: Aspire：模型能否从模糊目标自我进化？
items.note: 研究LLM在模糊目标下自我解释、学习和评估，挑战传统明确任务设定，适合自我进化研究。

items.title_en: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
items.summary: We introduce SolarWM, a fully open foundation for building interactive video world models from data preparation through long-horizon inference. Training across heterogeneous data sources and video backbones is challenging: datasets differ in temporal scale, camera geometry, visual quality, motion, and captioning styles, while video generators use distinct representations and architectures. items.title_cn: SolarWM：长时程视频世界模型的开源数据与可扩展训练
items.note: 提供全开放视频世界模型构建流程，处理异构数据，适合视频预测和世界模型方向。

items.title_en: EarlyEval: Cheaper Agent Evaluation via Early Outcome Prediction
items.summary: Evaluating LLM agents is essential for guiding their development, yet it has grown prohibitively expensive: a single pass of a frontier model over an agentic benchmark can cost hundreds to thousands of dollars, a price paid repeatedly across iterative development cycles. Prior efforts, centered on benchmark distillation, reduce the number of evaluation tasks but leave the cost of executing each retained task untouched. items.title_cn: EarlyEval：通过早期结果预测降低代理评估成本
items.note: 预测代理任务结果以提前终止，减少评估开销，适合高效评估方法。

items.title_en: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
items.summary: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. items.title_en: Qwen-Drive-1.0: An Initial Step towards a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Autonomous Driving
items.summary: We present Qwen-Drive-1.0, an initial step towards a vision-language foundation model for autonomous driving. Qwen-Drive-1.0 retains the architecture of the pretrained vision-language model (VLM) and integrates 3D perception, visual question answering, and motion planning within a unified framework. items.title_en: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
items.summary: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. items.title_en: UI-Venus-2 Technical Report
items.summary: Multimodal GUI agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for digital task automation, yet transitioning from benchmark-oriented models to dependable real-world applications remains challenging due to limited environment coverage, brittle task construction, and unreliable reward verification. In this work, we present UI-Venus-2, a general-purpose foundation GUI agent designed to operate across mobile, web, and desktop environments through a unified closed-loop reasoning-action framework. items.title_en: ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training
items.summary: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). items.title_en: Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling
items.summary: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated individually. items.title_en: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
items.summary: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events. We present DreamX-Creator 1.0, a compact native joint audio-video generation system centered on a 7B generator. items.title_en: GenFirst: Generation Before Reconstruction for Stable End-to-End Latent Generative Modeling
items.summary: Latent generative models typically follow a two-stage pipeline, training a variational autoencoder for reconstruction and then a generative model on the frozen latent space. items.title_en: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
items.summary: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. items.title_en: Beyond Data Scaling: Representation-Centric Continued Pre-training for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: Scaling robot data is crucial for building generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, yet robot trajectories are harder to scale than web-scale image-text data because embodied collection is costly and sparsely covers the physical world. items.summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. items.title_en: Agentic Artifact Creation: Systems, Evaluation, Principles, and Opportunities
items.summary: Generative models can turn natural-language prompts into images, text, code, and other content, lowering the cost of producing drafts and components. items.title_en: Code as Worlds: Agentic Discovery of Executable World Representations for Physical Reasoning
items.summary: Physical understanding and reasoning depend on forming compact and generalizable representations of the world. items.title_cn: 代码即世界：物理推理的可执行世界表示的代理发现
items.note: 用代码表示物理世界机制，提升推理能力，适合物理推理和神经符号方法。

huggingface.models_summary: 这些热门模型反映了AI正朝着多模态（文本+图像+视频）和轻量化方向发展。比如Qwen3.8-27B能看图聊天，MiniCPM5-2B也是多模态，而Spark-X2.5-4B和量化版本则追求在普通设备上运行。此外，TimesFM专注时间序列预测，说明AI在专业领域也在深入。对于想跟进AI圈和备考的人，要注意多模态能力成为标配，同时轻量化和高效部署是实际应用的关键。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文主要围绕大模型效率优化（如扩散加速、KV缓存压缩）、多模态生成（音视频、图像）、智能体训练与评估（自我进化、蒸馏、环境构建）、以及特定领域应用（自动驾驶、机器人、教育）。热门方向包括在线策略蒸馏、多智能体协作、世界模型、以及开源训练流程。新手应记住的关键词有：扩散模型、MoE、KV缓存、蒸馏、多模态、智能体、世界模型、后训练、因果推断、以及端到端生成。
